title: A genuine field named _value stays distinct from the flattener _value sentinel
rationale: MapFlattener uses the bare string "_value" as a sentinel in five places. Escaping is what currently keeps a real field of that name safe, and that safety is accidental and one cleanup away from breaking. The nested doubling also probes the reconstructor own _value wrapper.
catchesBugClass: Sentinel/user-namespace collision on the flattener side, mirroring NP-022 on the reconstructor side. Pins that the protection is escaping, so a refactor which moves the sentinel comparison to unescaped names fails loudly.
cannotCatch: It contains no arrays, so it never reaches the three sites where "_value" is inserted RAW into the same map that receives escaped field names. A _value collision inside a nested array of maps is precisely what this cannot see.

predicted.detail: No sentinel comparison matches, because every user-supplied segment carries its escape.
